description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Notify the Collective Agreement entered into between Habarana Lodge Limited and the Food Beverages & Tobacco Industries Employees Union (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves regulatory matters related to labor relations, employment terms, and salary structures, making it a legal/regulatory gazette that establishes binding terms under statutory authority.
